items.title: Putter Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 27, 2024
items.q: there was a saxophone player out here, Big Jay McNeely.

ctx.x: And what kind of tunes would they have been playing? © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-
Well we were playing things like “Moonlight in Vermont,” “Blue Moon,” and there was a saxophone player out here, Big Jay McNeely.
